events.title: Moth Infestation
events.description: Patchwork moths nibble spare seams in the satchel.

choices.text: Feed a spare part to the moths (+2 scraps)
Fumigate the satchel (spend 1 scrap)
Escape before the moths spread

events.title: The Dye Vat
events.description: Indigo thread waits to strengthen a sewn body part.

choices.text: Raise a worn part one tier (spend 3 scraps)
Skim dyed thread (+1 scrap)
Leave the vat

events.title: Frayed Debt Parcel
events.description: Borrowed stitches offer stronger spare parts at a cost to composure.

choices.text: Take a tier II claw (requires DARK or SNUFFED candlelight, +25 fray to the party)
Take a tier II moth wing (+25 fray to the party)
Gather loose thread (+1 scrap)

events.title: The Needle Toll
events.description: The front living pioneer may pay six HP for a rare spare. Seven HP are required to pay safely.

choices.text: Front living pioneer pays 6 HP for a tier III claw
Pocket loose thread (+1 scrap)

events.title: The Glassfront Pin Cabinet
events.description: A giant glass-front sewing cabinet looms above the doll-sized passage; behind warped panes a plump button-eyed keeper sorts copper pins into black velvet drawers.

choices.text: Open a draughty pin tray (+3 scraps, -8 candle, +4 fray each)
Spend 2 scraps bracing the candle wick (+15 candle, -4 fray each)
Let the cabinet's velvet drawers close

events.title: The Moonblack Paperweight
events.description: A moonblack glass paperweight pins a torn house plan to the floorboards; a small cream-felt mapkeeper waits beneath its cold reflection, holding an ink-stained spool.

choices.text: Pay 16 gold for a reassuring house plan (-10 fray each)
Lift the shadowed weight (+23 gold, -10 candle, +7 fray each)
Leave the black glass holding down the plan

events.title: The Cinder-Brass Bedwarmer
events.description: A bedwarmer the size of a wagon glows behind a perforated brass lid; a soot-dark round ragdoll steadies its long wooden handle beside a threadbare carpet.

choices.text: When the candle gutters, borrow embers; gain light but fray the dolls
Sift cooling ashes for scraps; dim the candle and ease fray
Leave the bedwarmer glowing in the dark

events.title: The Keyhole Choir
events.description: A brass keyhole towers above the doll-sized skirting board. Three round, button-eyed singers sway behind its dark throat, and their humming makes the candle flame bow toward the door.

choices.text: Follow the warm humming; mend the dolls, kindle the wick, fray their seams
Spend scraps to quiet Wren and ease the dolls' fray
Leave the little choir singing behind the door

events.title: The Compass of Loose Ends
events.description: A dinner-plate compass sits on a vast overturned spool. Its needle is a bent knitting pin, turning toward a knot that only the little hooded dolls seem able to read.

choices.text: Let the Yarn Ranger trace the knot (+2 scraps, -9 candle, +6 fray each; requires Yarn Ranger)
Trade gold for a quiet bearing to calm the dolls
Leave the needle turning in circles

events.title: The Veiled Wardrobe Mirror
events.description: A wardrobe mirror looms like a silver wall. A small stitched doll in the glass wears a lace veil and copies every movement a heartbeat too late.

choices.text: Pry the silver seam for a rich purse; dim the wick and fray every doll
Pin the veil back with a scrap to soothe the dolls
Pass without looking into the silver again

events.title: The Glass-Eyed Pendulum
events.description: A toppled hall clock blocks the doll-sized corridor. Its pendulum swings past a black glass eye, and a button-eyed keeper holds the wick beneath its ticking teeth.

choices.text: Feed the clock's wick and quiet the dolls
Break off a brass tooth and take its spool
Back away from the ticking glass

events.title: The Skirting Listening Shell
events.description: A pale spiral shell is sewn into the tall skirting board. Four little voices whisper from its mouth while the corridor candle bends toward the wall.

choices.text: Let the Lantern Monk answer the whisper
Pay to quiet the voices
Leave the shell to whisper
